description: 大規模 DML のチャンク分割実行 (#2020) の SQL 生成の実装横断ゴールデンベクタ。Rust の db::chunked_dml (build_chunk_sql / build_count_sql) と、フロントの components/chunkedDml.ts を同じ入力で固定する。cases は成功ケース (set が無ければ DELETE、あれば UPDATE)、errors は拒否ケース (drivers 省略時は全ドライバで同じ理由コードで拒否される)。新しい境界ケースはこの 1 ファイルに追記すれば両言語へ反映される。

expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "users" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "users" WHERE (created_at < '2020-01-01') LIMIT 1000)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "users" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "users" WHERE (created_at < '2020-01-01') LIMIT 1000)

cases.note: UPDATE は SET 句をそのまま載せる

expected.postgres: UPDATE "orders" SET status = 'archived' WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "orders" WHERE (status = 'old') LIMIT 500)
expected.sqlite: UPDATE "orders" SET status = 'archived' WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "orders" WHERE (status = 'old') LIMIT 500)

cases.note: DB 修飾 (SQLite は修飾しない)

expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "app"."t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "app"."t" WHERE (id > 10) LIMIT 1)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (id > 10) LIMIT 1)

cases.note: 識別子の引用 (バッククォート / ダブルクォートの二重化)

expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "d`b"."we`ird""t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "d`b"."we`ird""t" WHERE (x = 1) LIMIT 10)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "we`ird""t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "we`ird""t" WHERE (x = 1) LIMIT 10)

cases.note: WHERE の前後の空白は落とし、OR を含む条件は括弧で包まれる

expected.mysql: DELETE FROM `t` WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2) LIMIT 100
expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2) LIMIT 100)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2) LIMIT 100)

count.mysql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `t` WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2)
count.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2)
count.sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1 OR b = 2)

cases.note: 上限ちょうどのバッチサイズ

expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1) LIMIT 100000)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (a = 1) LIMIT 100000)

cases.note: 文字列リテラル中の ; -- /* は許可 (引用符内)

expected.mysql: DELETE FROM `t` WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d') LIMIT 10
expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d') LIMIT 10)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d') LIMIT 10)

count.mysql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `t` WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d')
count.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d')
count.sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (note = 'a;b -- c /* d')

cases.note: 文字列リテラル中の '' 二重化

expected.postgres: UPDATE "t" SET x = 'it''s' WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (y = 'it''s') LIMIT 10)
expected.sqlite: UPDATE "t" SET x = 'it''s' WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (y = 'it''s') LIMIT 10)

cases.note: サブクエリ入りの条件 (括弧が釣り合う)
cases.where: id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1))

expected.mysql: DELETE FROM `t` WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1))) LIMIT 10
expected.postgres: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1))) LIMIT 10)
expected.sqlite: DELETE FROM "t" WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1))) LIMIT 10)

count.mysql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `t` WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1)))
count.postgres: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1)))
count.sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "t" WHERE (id IN (SELECT id FROM u WHERE (a = 1)))

cases.note: UPDATE の SET に複数列と式

expected.mysql: UPDATE `t` SET n = n + 1, m = NULL WHERE (k = 1) LIMIT 10
expected.postgres: UPDATE "t" SET n = n + 1, m = NULL WHERE ctid IN (SELECT ctid FROM "t" WHERE (k = 1) LIMIT 10)
expected.sqlite: UPDATE "t" SET n = n + 1, m = NULL WHERE rowid IN (SELECT rowid FROM "t" WHERE (k = 1) LIMIT 10)

errors.note: 空の WHERE は拒否 (全件操作を防ぐ)
バッチサイズが上限超え
引用符の外の ; は拒否 (文の追加)
-- コメントは閉じ括弧を食うので拒否
MySQL の # コメントは MySQL だけ拒否
閉じ括弧が多い (括弧を抜けて LIMIT を外す試み)
MySQL は \' が引用符を閉じない (閉じ忘れとして拒否)
PostgreSQL のドル引用は解釈しない
PostgreSQL の E 文字列は解釈しない
